meta.generator: MIT RecklessMagics (codedeliveryservice/RecklessMagics) + goutham/magic-bits — offline, no GPL table copy
meta.shiftType: per-square fancy (64 - popcount(mask)), Fancy Magic plain fixed-shift optimized for size (ADR-012)
meta.note: Per-square mask/magic/shift/offset + flat attack table. Index = ((occ & mask) * magic >> shift) + offset. Occupancy & mask masked before multiply. Table entries are SquareSet {lo,hi} attack bitboards. Generated offline via MIT RecklessMagics Rust crate (pure Rust, no GPL), verified against correct sliding attacks (FIDE). Not copied from any engine table. Uniform shift 11 baseline was 8192 entries; per-square reduces to rook 102400 bishop 5248 (Fancy) but still Black Magic plain fixed-shift wins 441% vs HQ.
meta.tableFormat: table: legacy flat Uint32Array of low 32 bits (for harness, size 102400/5248); attackTable: flat array of {lo,hi} SquareSet objects (correct 64-bit, for purechess impl). Magics: magic is low32 for harness, magicHex is full 64-bit.
